## Goal

Invoke the same deletion behavior from the Delete key.

## Acceptance criteria

* Delete removes the active selection only when focus belongs to the diagram editor.
* It does nothing while the user edits text, a dialog, a menu, or an action popup.
* Keyboard and toolbox deletion use the same service operation and cascading rules.
* The listener is installed and removed with the editor lifecycle.

## State and rendering rule

The keyboard handler delegates to the same granular deletion operation as the toolbox. It owns no diagram state and introduces no additional notification or rerender path.

## Dependencies

[F\_297](F_297_add_diagram_delete_tool.md).

## Goal

Add a Delete action to the Edit toolbox section.

## Scope

Delete the complete selection through one mutation batch. Removing a node also removes attached edges and its group memberships. Removing an edge also removes its fragment references. Empty groups and fragments remain unless they were selected or become structurally invalid.

## Acceptance criteria

* Delete is disabled for empty selection.
* Cascading changes leave a valid diagram and appear in the semantic change set.
* The selection is cleared of removed identities.
* One activation produces one mutation publication.
* Current diagram data remains unchanged.

## State and rendering rule

Deletion mutates only affected collection memberships and references. Collection hosts receive new ID-list snapshots only for collections whose membership changed; surviving objects retain references and do not rerender unless one of their own references changed. There is no complete-diagram publication.

## Dependencies

[F\_276](F_276_add_diagram_mutation_operations.md), [F\_277](F_277_track_diagram_changes.md), and [F\_290](F_290_add_diagram_selection_service.md).

import { isApplePlatform, type KeyboardShortcut } from './keyboard_platform'
import { register } from '../service_injector'

export interface KeyboardShortcutBinding extends KeyboardShortcut {
    id: string
    run: () => void
}

/** Owns the single window listener used to dispatch application-global shortcuts. */
export class KeyboardShortcutService {
    private readonly bindings = new Map<string, KeyboardShortcutBinding>()

    private listenerTarget: Window | null = null

    private readonly handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
        for (const binding of this.bindings.values()) {
            if (!KeyboardShortcutService.matches(event, binding)) continue

            event.preventDefault()
            binding.run()
            return
        }
    }

    private static matches(event: KeyboardEvent, binding: KeyboardShortcut) {
        const applePlatform = isApplePlatform()
        const expectedCtrl = binding.mod && !applePlatform
        const expectedMeta = binding.mod && applePlatform

        return event.key.toLowerCase() === binding.key.toLowerCase()
            && event.ctrlKey === expectedCtrl
            && event.metaKey === expectedMeta
            && event.shiftKey === binding.shift
            && event.altKey === binding.alt
    }

    register(binding: KeyboardShortcutBinding) {
        if (this.bindings.has(binding.id)) throw new Error(`Keyboard shortcut already registered: ${binding.id}`)

        this.bindings.set(binding.id, binding)
        if (this.bindings.size === 1) {
            this.listenerTarget = window
            this.listenerTarget.addEventListener('keydown', this.handleKeyDown)
        }

        return () => {
            if (this.bindings.get(binding.id) !== binding) return

            this.bindings.delete(binding.id)
            if (this.bindings.size === 0 && this.listenerTarget) {
                this.listenerTarget.removeEventListener('keydown', this.handleKeyDown)
                this.listenerTarget = null
            }
        }
    }
}

export const keyboardShortcutService = register('keyboardShortcutService', new KeyboardShortcutService())

No TodoWrite tool in this session, so blocks listed inline as tasks.

## Change Plan — F_298 diagram Delete key

**Context found:**
- `diagram_selection_service.ts:174` `deleteSelection()` — the shared operation F_297 built; toolbox button `diagram_delete_button.tsx` calls it.
- Existing keyboard-hook precedent: `use_diagram_tool.ts:41` `useCancelDiagramInteractionOnEscape` — window `keydown`, `defaultPrevented` guard, `useEffect` add/remove.
- `resizable_popper.tsx:477` renders `role="dialog"`, so the toolbox popup *and* MUI dialogs are both caught by one `[role="dialog"]` exclusion.
- Diagram nodes render as MUI `ButtonBase` (`diagram_node.tsx`), so clicking a node puts focus inside the editor subtree.

**Ambiguity I must resolve — "focus belongs to the diagram editor":** rubber-band selection on empty canvas calls `preventDefault()` on pointerdown, so focus can stay on `document.body` while a selection exists. Strict "activeElement inside editor" would break that common path. My rule: allow when the focused element is inside the editor root **or** when nothing owns focus (`null`/`document.body`), and always block when focus sits in text entry, a dialog, a menu, or a popup. Say the word if you want strict containment instead.

### Task 1 — Focus-guarded Delete-key hook
New file `app/src/components/diagram_view/use_diagram_delete_key.ts`:
- `DIAGRAM_EDITOR_ROOT_ATTRIBUTE = 'data-diagram-editor'`.
- Ignore event when `defaultPrevented`, `key !== 'Delete'`, or any of ctrl/meta/alt held.
- Block when `activeElement.closest(...)` matches `input, textarea, select, [contenteditable=""], [contenteditable="true"], [role="dialog"], [role="menu"], [role="menuitem"], [role="listbox"], [role="combobox"], [role="textbox"]`.
- Otherwise require focus inside `[data-diagram-editor]`, or no focus owner.
- On pass: `selection.deleteSelection()`; `preventDefault()` only when it returned true.
- `useEffect` installs/removes the window listener — mount/unmount ties it to editor lifecycle.

### Task 2 — Wire into the editor lifecycle
`editable_diagram.tsx`: root `Box` of `EditableDiagram` gets the `data-diagram-editor` attribute, and `EditableDiagram` calls the hook with its `selection` prop. `EditableDiagram` subscribes to no state, so it never rerenders — the listener is installed once and torn down on unmount. No new state, no new publication path.

### Task 3 — Tests
New `use_diagram_delete_key.test.tsx` (mirrors `DeleteSelectionStub` style from `diagram_delete_button.test.tsx`):
1. Delete with focus inside editor root → `deleteSelection` called once, event defaultPrevented.
2. Delete with focus in an `<input>`, and in a `[role="dialog"]` container → not called.
3. Delete while focus sits on an unrelated outside element → not called.
4. Ctrl+Delete and other keys → not called.
5. After unmount, Delete → not called (listener removed).
6. Same service operation as toolbox: one `DiagramDeleteButton` click and one Delete press both hit the same `deleteSelection` stub.

Then run only `use_diagram_delete_key.test.tsx`, `diagram_delete_button.test.tsx`, `editable_diagram.test.tsx` plus `npm run typecheck`, and set `status: ready` in `C:\Users\janbo\Documents\dev\md2\design\feature_descriptions\F_298_add_diagram_delete_key_support.md`.

entries.content:
Done. All three blocks implemented.

**Files:**
- `app/src/components/diagram_view/use_diagram_delete_key.ts` (new) — `useDeleteDiagramSelectionOnDeleteKey`. Window `keydown` listener installed by `useEffect`, removed on unmount. Runs `selection.deleteSelection()` — the same service operation the toolbox button calls — and calls `preventDefault()` only when that operation reported a deletion.
- `app/src/components/diagram_view/editable_diagram.tsx` — `EditableDiagram` root Box now carries `data-diagram-editor`, and the component calls the hook with its `selection` prop. `EditableDiagram` subscribes to nothing, so it never rerenders; the listener mounts once with the editor. No new state, no new publication path.
- `app/src/components/diagram_view/use_diagram_delete_key.test.tsx` (new) — 8 tests.

**Focus rule as implemented:** the handler bails on `defaultPrevented`, on any key other than `Delete`, and on Alt/Ctrl/Meta. It then blocks whenever the focused element sits inside `input`, `textarea`, `select`, `contenteditable`, or a `role` of `dialog`/`menu`/`menuitem`/`listbox`/`combobox`/`textbox`. `ResizablePopper` renders `role="dialog"`, so that one selector covers the toolbox action popup and MUI dialogs alike. Otherwise it requires focus inside `[data-diagram-editor]`, **or** no focus owner at all (`null`/`body`) — that last allowance is the assumption I flagged in the plan: rubber-band selection calls `preventDefault()` on pointerdown, so a rectangle selection leaves focus on `body`, and strict containment would make the keyboard unable to delete what it just selected.

**Verification:** `use_diagram_delete_key.test.tsx`, `diagram_delete_button.test.tsx`, `editable_diagram.test.tsx`, `diagram_toolbox.test.tsx` all pass; `npm run typecheck` clean; eslint clean on the three touched files. The last test renders the real `EditableDiagram` with real services and confirms Delete removes the selected node and empties the selection.

Spec at `C:\Users\janbo\Documents\dev\md2\design\feature_descriptions\F_298_add_diagram_delete_key_support.md` now has `status: ready`.
